title: Over P500,000 suspected marijuana intercepted at Zambo Sur delivery hub

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Anti-narcotics agents intercepted a parcel containing over four kilograms of suspected dried marijuana leaves worth over P500,000 during an interdiction operation at a local delivery hub in Labangan, Zamboanga del Sur on Saturday. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-9 (PDEA-9) – Zamboanga del Sur Provincial Office (ZDSPO) reported that operatives, together with the PDEA Special Enforcement Service (SES) K9 Unit, conducted the operation at around 12:05 p.m. in Barangay Bulanit.
